note: The fee model changes with this release: the portfolio batching fee is 0.25% (0x's own ~0.15% makes ~0.4% all-in on aggregator legs), the direct-swap fee is 0.4%, and 100% of every Spectrum fee now buys and burns PRISM; there is no integrator split. Both money contracts are a NEW deployed generation with new call shapes, seated per chain in deployments.json (feeGeneration: 2), and every safety gate (the shown-vs-signed laws, the selector pins, settlement-decimals verification against the token itself) is generation-aware. Version upgrades that the in-kind path cannot serve now run as a protected sell-then-buy through each version's own pool, spending only the measured proceeds. The portfolio's first open gains a guided tour; every refusal on a money surface now carries the button its sentence names. BREAKING: sites pinning the old batcher/wrapper call shapes must update; bundles ship enabled on the canonical config.
